dedupe_keys.name: fluid a fine grained lightweight urban signalized intersection dataset of dense conflict trajectories

description: FLUID: A Fine-Grained Lightweight Urban Signalized-Intersection Dataset of Dense Conflict Trajectories is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yiyang Chen, Zhigang Wu. The FLUID dataset provides fine-grained trajectories with a unique focus on dense traffic conflicts at typical urban signalized intersections. Captured by drones, it contains approximately 5 hours of data covering over 20,000 traffic participants across three distinct intersection types. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 17685158438 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
